rule: Eight held-out sequences, two per total length 3,072, 4,608, 6,144 and 8,192 tokens (four length groups within 8,192); each is a prompt of (total - 16) tokens drawn at a random offset from one ordinary text of the engine's own repository, and the 16 positions after it are the model's own greedy continuation at capture time, so a sequence's total attended length is its group's. Sequences used by any other fixture of this task are excluded, as is any window sharing a 32-token run with one of them or with a sequence already drawn here. Nothing about any engine's or the author's output is consulted.
